name: Size / co-VC Dimension
witness_verification: For #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $2^n$ and $0$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
